name: England Heritage
notes: Designed via the per-theme design card (Phase 0b): pointed Gothic Tudor arch, quatrefoil tracery rails, stained-glass rose window crown, White Cliffs of Dover + parish village vignettes, three lions of England shield. Built from diffui option england-v2-b (twin-lancet window). Canonical box 900x1500 (skinnier house default). Slot detection uses connected-component flood fill with a morphological closing pass on the ivory mask, so a thin gold mullion dividing a twin-lancet window doesn't split it into two components. Silhouette detection excludes a border margin ring before flooding, so a velvet fold catching warm bounce light (same hue/sat range as the card's own gold) can't bleed into the cutout.
